activity.notes: While continuing as regent and heir under Empress Zewditu, Ras Tafari was crowned negus (king) in 1928. A 1929 United States-Ethiopia treaty styles him 'King Tafari, Heir Apparent to the Throne and Regent Plenipotentiary of the Empire of Ethiopia.' ATLAS therefore records this concurrent royal title separately from his 1916-1930 regency and ends it with his accession as emperor in 1930.

sources.title: Haile Selassie — Encyclopedia.com
sources.citation_text: The biography states that Ras Tafari was named king in 1928 while remaining regent and became emperor in 1930.

sources.title: Treaty of Conciliation, United States–Ethiopia, 1929 — Library of Congress
sources.citation_text: The 1929 treaty formally styles him 'His Majesty, King Tafari, Heir Apparent to the Throne and Regent Plenipotentiary of the Empire of Ethiopia.'
